mu_name_from: MuMain's _enum.h: MONSTER_CHAIN_SCORPION = 27 is the server's type, and CreateMonster answers it with OpenMonsterModel(MONSTER_MODEL_CHAIN_SCORPION), which is 20, so the file is Monster21.bmd. OpenMU's Version075 Noria.cs names number 27 'Chain Scorpion' at level 5 with 80 health. Its Korean ID in CreateMonster is 고리전갈, ring scorpion - the chain is the segmented tail.
monster_from: ZzzCharacter.cpp, CreateMonster, case MONSTER_CHAIN_SCORPION: `c->Object.Scale = 1.1f` and nothing else - no weapon, no BlendMesh, no HiddenMesh, no Level. MODEL_CHAIN_SCORPION is not in CreateCharacter's weapon link switch either, so it holds nothing.
rig_from:
Seven actions, slots 0 to 6, six keys each but the seven-key death; the walk is the locked one. Nine bones: Box08 the body, Box01 to Box06 the tail's six segments each the child of the last, light_point on the end of them at 7, and Cylinder01 hung off the body at 8. Bone 7 is the one the client reads - see sprites_from.

No BoneHead set in ZzzOpenData's case for this model, which is the Goblin's line and not this one's.

Play speeds are OpenMonsterModel's defaults with `case MONSTER_MODEL_CHAIN_SCORPION: b->Actions[MONSTER01_WALK].PlaySpeed = 0.4f`.
sheet_from: One sheet, Data/Monster/bug3.OZJ, 32 by 64 and no alpha - byte-identical (md5) to the copy under LEGACY's old build. Decoded under a scorpion_ prefix: bug3 is the third of a numbered family and the other two are some other insect's.
sheet_materials_from: Read off the sheet, magnified: an amber shell studded with rounded bosses, dark seams between plates and a curl of green at one edge. A shell is chitin, which is what the Spider is dressed in for the same reason.
sounds_from: Five files off `case MONSTER_MODEL_CHAIN_SCORPION` in ZzzOpenData: mScorpion1, mScorpion2, mScorpionAttack1, mScorpionAttack2 and mScorpionDie, with SetMonsterSound(..., 77, 78, 79, 80, 81) - offsets from SOUND_MONSTER_BULL1 at 210, so 287 to 291, SOUND_MONSTER_SCORPION1 to SCORPIONDIE, exactly the five it loads. Filed as chainscorpion_move, _attack, _shock and _die.
islands_from: All sixteen chitin, which is what sheet_materials says and what the shell is. They were skin until 2026-09-21: islands.py gives a new island the monster profile's default, which is skin, and never reads sheet_materials, so the declaration above was made and the bake never saw it - the trap Spider01 records, and the one the Lich and the Giant met again.
